title: An offcanvas panel opened with a backdrop must keep keyboard focus inside the panel
summary: With body scrolling and a backdrop both enabled, opening the offcanvas leaves focus on the page behind the backdrop, so Tab moves through obscured page controls instead of the panel.
consumer: Author-written expense report page with a scroll-enabled, backdrop-enabled help panel around the unchanged upstream source at buggyCommit; transitions are disabled in page CSS and an import map adds the .js extensions Bootstrap's extensionless source imports need in a browser.
